{{Quote|My position is actually different from that of most warriors, as I've been named a Trial-born of the family. Most warriors' positions automatically cease when they leave the military, but mine carries the possibility that I will be deemed worthy and matched permanently to the Family. I may even be granted the position of ranking distant, which will tie my descendants and bloodline into that of the Family.|[[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]]|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
'''Trial-born''' was a [[Chiss family/Legends|family]] rank of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. In the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] hierarchy, it was situated above [[Merit adoptive/Legends|merit adoptive]] and below the rank of [[Ranking distant/Legends|ranking distant]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> The Chiss individuals reached the rank by being "born to trial."<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref> Unlike the merit adoptives, the Trial-born were given the opportunity of being permanently [[Rematching/Legends|matched]] to the family. In some cases, a Trial-born could be granted the rank of a ranking distant. Trial-borns could have a hearing at a family stronghold to renounce their family rank.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
